email.heading: Email
email.verifyHint: We'll send a confirmation link to the new address. Your email changes after you confirm it.
email.immediateHint: Your email changes as soon as you save.
email.adminOnly: Your organization lets only administrators change email addresses.
email.pending: Waiting for confirmation of {{email}} — open the link sent to that address to confirm.

password.heading: Password
password.hint: You don't need your current password. We'll email you every time your password changes.
password.rulesTitle: The password doesn't meet your organization's rules:

rules.pattern: Must match your organization's required format
rules.history: Must not reuse a recent password
rules.blacklisted: This password is too easy to guess
rules.other: Doesn't meet your organization's password rules

mfa.heading: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
mfa.lastDeviceHint: You can't remove your last device while your organization requires 2FA — add a new device first, then remove the old one.
mfa.removeDescription: Codes from this device will no longer work for signing in.
mfa.enrolStep1: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator)
mfa.qrLabel: QR code for adding your D-Contact account to an authenticator app
mfa.manualKey: Or type this key in the app
mfa.enrolStep2: Enter the 6-digit code from the app and name the device
mfa.label: Device name

policy.intro: This policy applies to everyone in your organization. Requiring 2FA takes effect at the next sign-in; people already signed in stay signed in.
policy.mfaHint: People without 2FA must set it up before their next sign-in.
policy.reasonHint: 3–500 characters, kept in the change history
policy.adminOnly: Only your organization's administrators can view and change the account policy.
